function.name: query_local_imessage_history
function.description: Searches the user's local Apple iMessage database for historical context. Use this when the user asks about past conversations, links, or data sent via text/iMessage. This is a secure, local-only shadow API.

search_term.description: The keyword, phrase, or name to search for in the message history.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default 10).

function.name: semantic_local_file_search
function.description: Searches the user's local Mac filesystem (Documents, Photos, PDFs) by semantic concept rather than exact filename. Uses local vector embeddings. Use this when the user asks to find a vague file, document, or image based on what it contains.

concept.description: The abstract concept to search for (e.g., 'a receipt from a coffee shop', 'a photo of a beach sunset').

file_types.description: Optional file extensions to filter by (e.g., ['pdf'], ['jpg', 'png']).
